subject: Redwood + BrightLane: ACE listing -- risk items and schedule review
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@brightlane.health>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Simmons <paul.simmons@aws-partner.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + BrightLane ACE registration & listing timeline

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BrightLane is excited about Redwood for inference on our clinical summarization pipeline. AWS recommended we kick off ACE registration early so we can get co-sell support for our Q4 pilots.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood submit ACE registration and the initial marketplace listing by Oct 15?
- We need a short PDM/PSM intro to finalize the co-sell motion and confirm who will own casework post-launch.
- Security/compliance ask: can you confirm audit log retention and whether you support customer-managed KMS?

Attached: BrightLane_SOW_draft.pdf (first-pass SOW and expected scopes).

Happy to jump on a quick call — Paul from AWS is CC'd to help coordinate.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightLane Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@brightlane.health>
Cc: Paul Simmons <paul.simmons@aws-partner.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + BrightLane ACE registration & listing timeline

Marta — thanks for the clear write-up and the SOW. Short answers up-front: we can target an ACE submission and an initial listing draft by Oct 15, but there are three items we need from BrightLane to hit that date:

1) A confirmed product description + logo and 1-2 screenshots (marketing assets)
2) A contact for AWS procurement and final PO timing (we need the procurement cadence to align with your desired go-live)
3) Confirmation on data residency (US-only or dual region) and whether you will require Private deployment (VPC) at launch.

Proposed next steps:
- PDM/PSM intro call: Thu Sep 9 at 10:00 PT or Fri Sep 10 at 11:00 PT — which works for you?
- I'll attach our marketplace checklist and loop in Aditya for the security/technical pre-reqs.

If you want to prioritize earlier, we can do a staged listing where we publish a limited listing (no public procurement link) while procurement completes.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Field GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@brightlane.health>, Paul Simmons <paul.simmons@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + BrightLane ACE registration & listing timeline

Kim / Marta — looping in the technical checklist. Quick notes from infra:
- We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and for Dedicated customers with a commercial agreement. For hosted listings, we can document encryption-at-rest and KMS options in the security section of the listing.
- Log retention: default 90 days in hosted, configurable up to 365 on Dedicated/Private with archive exports. If BrightLane needs >365 we should plan for an export-to-S3 pattern.
- Marketplace Checklist: Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx (attached) includes required fields for ACE: marketing blurb, technical details, support SLAs, pricing model (usage vs subscription), and owner contacts.

Question for BrightLane: are there specific compliance artifacts (SOC2 Type II, penetration test report) you can share now for the listing? That speeds approvals.

--Aditya
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta@brightlane.health>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Paul Simmons <paul.simmons@aws-partner.com>, procurement@brightlane.health
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + BrightLane ACE registration & listing timeline

Thanks Aditya — good to know on the KMS / retention options. We can provide SOC2 Type II summary and our pen test executive summary by Sep 15.

Procurement note: our purchasing cadence aims for a signed SOW by Oct 1 and a PO by Oct 12. If Redwood can have the ACE application ready for AWS review by Oct 15, that fits our timeline.

About residency: we will start US-only for the pilot. We do not require Private deployment day-one, but would like a plan to move to VPC within 3 months if pilot success criteria are met.

I've attached BrightLane_SOW_draft.pdf with a short procurement appendix.

Marta
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@brightlane.health>, Paul Simmons <paul.simmons@aws-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + BrightLane ACE registration & listing timeline — action tracker

Thanks everyone — summary and owners below so we have a single source of truth before the PDM/PSM intro.

Action items:
- Kimberley: draft ACE listing & marketing blurb (due Sep 20) — owner: kimberly_park@redwood.com
- Aditya: finalize technical answers and attach compliance artifacts (SOC2 summary) — due Sep 15; owner: aditya_rao@redwood.com
- BrightLane: confirm logo + screenshots + procurement PO timing (due Sep 14) — owner: marta@brightlane.health
- Soojin: prepare canary rollout + pricing landing page copy for marketplace (due Sep 22) — owner: soojin_lee@redwood.com
- Schedule: PDM/PSM intro call scheduled for Fri Sep 10, 11:00 PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321/BRIGHTLANE-2026 | DocuSign template for SOW: https://docusign.com/template/12X-rl

Let me know if anything needs to shift. If we keep to these dates we should be able to submit ACE materials to AWS for initial review by Oct 1 and a listing draft by Oct 15.

Laura Bennett
Head of Partner GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
